<p Style='page-break-before:always'>
<HR  SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">ROYAL DUTCH SHELL PLC </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">DIRECTORATE CHANGE </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Royal Dutch Shell plc (the
&#147;Company&#148;) announces that Guy Elliott has stood down as a <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Non-executive</FONT> Director of the Company with immediate effect. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Commenting on the announcement, Royal Dutch Shell plc chair, Charles Holliday said: &#147;We fully respect and appreciate Guy&#146;s decision which is related
to his involvement in legal proceedings regarding his former employment at Rio Tinto.&nbsp;We will miss his insightful counsel and leadership and would like to thank him for his seven years of valuable contribution to the Shell Board.&nbsp;We
sincerely hope he satisfactorily resolves those proceedings and, that in that event, he would like to be considered for rejoining the Board.&#148; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">October&nbsp;18, 2017 </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Linda M. Szymanski </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Company Secretary </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Royal Dutch Shell plc </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><U>Section&nbsp;430 (2B) Companies Act 2006 Statement </U></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">In
accordance with Section&nbsp;430 (2B) of the Companies Act 2006, the Company confirms that Guy Elliott will receive his annual base fee as a <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Non-executive</FONT> Director of the Company of &#128;135,000 per annum,
and additional fees in respect of his membership of the Corporate and Social Responsibility Committee and the Nomination and Succession Committee of &#128;17,250 per annum and &#128;12,000 per annum respectively, on a
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">pro-rata</FONT> basis up to and including his date of resignation. No other remuneration payment or payment for loss of office will be made. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">ENQUIRIES </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Shell Media Relations </B></P>

Investor Relations </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Europe: + 31 70 377 4540 </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">United
States: +1 832 337 2034 </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">LEI number of Royal Dutch Shell plc: 21380068P1DRHMJ8KU70 </P>
